dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Distinct pale white fringes along the edges of the posterior flight feathers against the dark gray ground.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Small, concentrated red patch at the anterior dorsal extremity.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Sharp, linear high-contrast boundary separating the red crown from the dark gray mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct white upper-tail covert patch and bold black-and-white transverse barring on the rectrices.
